words.prose: {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) begins the ayah inside a dependency rather than as an independent sentence. It packages the following clause, {{ar:دَعَوْا لِلرَّحْمَنِ وَلَدًا}} ({{tr:daʿaw lil-raḥmāni waladan}}), as the fact and cause that answers the near-collapse described in 19:90. Because the particle stands separately before the verb, the reader hears the causal scope open before the offending attribution itself arrives; the ayah is brief because the attribution alone is made to carry the explanatory load.

topics.headline: causal subordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 19:91 gives the grammatical cause of the catastrophe in 19:90 rather than starting a fresh scene.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) as the subordinator of a verbal complement, matching the CRITICAL rows that read the clause as the causal/content complement to 19:90.

topics.headline: visible clause scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the small opening particle makes the whole four-word attribution clause bear the explanatory burden.
topics.reason: The independent particle visibly precedes the verb and opens scope over the compressed clause, while attachment evidence keeps the whole clause subordinate.

words.prose: {{ar:دَعَوْا۟}} ({{tr:daʿaw}}) makes the cause a completed human speech-act: the claim has already been made while 19:90 shows creation still straining under its effect. Its plural ending keeps the agents grammatically present but unnamed, so attention falls on the act and its two complements. The verb's wider call/name/invoke range is narrowed by {{ar:لِلرَّحْمَنِ}} ({{tr:lil-raḥmāni}}) and {{ar:وَلَدًا}} ({{tr:waladan}}): this is not loose invocation but a voiced attribution of offspring to the Mercy-name. That same call-field also makes the inversion sharper beside proper calling of the divine name (17:110) and the earlier statement of the same claim in another frame (19:88).

topics.headline: completed speech-act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the offending utterance is presented as already accomplished while the cosmic reaction in 19:90 is still unfolding.
topics.reason: The local form is a perfect 3mp verb, and the boundary rows coherently contrast completed attribution with the suspended near-collapse of 19:90.

topics.headline: backgrounded plural agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the plural actors are encoded inside the verb while the ayah spends its words on the claim itself.
topics.reason: The verb carries 3mp agreement and attachment evidence treats the subject as morphologically present but not overtly resolved in the same clause.

topics.headline: attribution frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that several call and naming senses are funneled into one local ascription: assigning {{ar:وَلَدًا}} ({{tr:waladan}}) to {{ar:ٱلرَّحْمَن}} ({{tr:al-raḥmān}}).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL polysemy survives as speech-act pressure, but the local {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) complement plus direct object force an attribution frame rather than an unrestricted invocation or unrelated root branch.

topics.headline: inverted call echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that proper calling of {{ar:ٱلرَّحْمَن}} ({{tr:al-raḥmān}}) (17:110) is inverted here into calling an offspring for Him, while 19:88 stated the same claim with a different verb frame.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows give concrete references for proper invocation and for the earlier same-surah claim, and the local frame makes those echoes contrastive rather than controlling the parse.

topics.headline: scale disproportion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the disproportion between a compact human utterance and the massive created order reacting in 19:90.
topics.reason: The clause has only verb, governed divine name, and object, while boundary evidence ties that compact speech-act to the prior cosmic reaction.

words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) is the hinge that turns the verb into an attribution frame. It governs {{ar:ٱلرَّحْمَن}} ({{tr:al-raḥmān}}), so {{ar:وَلَدًا}} ({{tr:waladan}}) is assigned to Him rather than merely mentioned near His name. The particle's possible ranges of direction, possession, and relation are locally narrowed to dative attribution, with an adversarial undertone because the relation imposed is false. In recitation and spelling it fuses into {{ar:لِلرَّحْمَنِ}} ({{tr:lil-raḥmāni}}): preposition, article, and name are heard as one governed run, with the article's lām assimilating before rā before the final object lands.

topics.headline: dative attribution hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one small particle decides the claim's direction: offspring is assigned to {{ar:ٱلرَّحْمَن}} ({{tr:al-raḥmān}}).
topics.reason: The particle's broad semantic range is narrowed by forced local governance of the divine name as the complement of the attribution.

topics.headline: fused audible link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition is not only syntactic; its fusion with the following name lets the dependency be heard as one run.
topics.reason: The phonological rows are retained as audible form-payoff, but they are narrowed because assimilation and fusion do not add a separate lexical meaning.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the definite Mercy-name identified within the fused governed form

words.prose: {{ar:لِلرَّحْمَنِ}} ({{tr:lil-raḥmāni}}) places the definite Mercy-name in the governed recipient slot before the child-word is heard. Its case and fused preposition make the false relation grammatically precise: {{ar:ٱلرَّحْمَن}} ({{tr:al-raḥmān}}) is the one to whom {{ar:وَلَدًا}} ({{tr:waladan}}) is assigned. The fused sound joins preposition, article, and name in one run, and the assimilated article doubles the audible pressure on rā at the center of the attribution. The name's intensive mercy force and {{ar:ر ح م}} ({{tr:r-ḥ-m}}) kinship and womb-care field do not turn the name into a biological term; they make the intrusion of generated offspring language more jarring. Within Surah 19 the same name frames the claim and its answer: the claim appears at 19:88, this ayah gives its cause, 19:92 states its impossibility, and 19:93 answers offspring with universal servitude.

topics.headline: governed definite name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the false attribution targets a fixed divine name in a governed recipient role, not an open kinship slot.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence confirm the proper noun as genitive after {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}), contrasting its recipient role with the accusative object.

topics.headline: mercy-name category clash
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the mercy and womb-care field makes the following generated-offspring claim feel like a category error, while the proper name remains the selected local sense.
topics.reason: The root-family rows carry real semantic pressure, but they are narrowed so womb and kinship imagery does not replace the local proper-name function.

topics.headline: surah refutation arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that {{ar:ٱلرَّحْمَن}} ({{tr:al-raḥmān}}) recurs through the local claim-answer sequence: 19:88, 19:91, 19:92, and 19:93.
topics.reason: Same-surah and cross-surah echo rows survive as recurrence and formula evidence, but numeric or sweeping saturation claims are not carried beyond the supported repeated-name payoff.

topics.headline: phonetic governance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition, article, and name are heard as a compressed governed unit before the object arrives.
topics.reason: The surface form visibly joins the preposition and definite name, and the phonetic rows add audible pressure without changing the syntax.

topics.headline: creation response boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior collapse scene in 19:90 is read as creation reacting before the misattributed Mercy-name in 19:91.
topics.reason: The boundary link is useful, but the prostration-like pressure remains a contextual resonance rather than the local lexical sense of the divine name.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative offspring or child, locally the object/content of the false attribution
words.root_gloss_range: offspring, child, parenthood, birth, generatedness, and related kinship forms; local sense is concrete generated offspring, not metaphorical favor

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the preceding terminal demolition word recalled by cadence
the repeated offspring object in the immediate refutation sequence
the plural variant used as scope evidence for the offspring category

words.prose: {{ar:وَلَدًۭا}} ({{tr:waladan}}) is the accusative object that finally names the content of the claim. Its indefinite singular form does not narrow the issue to one named child; it lets even one unspecified offspring stand for the whole category being rejected. The {{ar:و ل د}} ({{tr:w-l-d}}) field keeps the word concrete: birth, generatedness, parenthood, and offspring are what collide with the governed Mercy-name. The word also occupies the ayah's closing position, so the biological category becomes the acoustic landing point after 19:90's rupture; its terminal -adan cadence answers {{ar:هَدًّا}} ({{tr:haddan}}) in 19:90 and is immediately repeated by {{ar:وَلَدًا}} ({{tr:waladan}}) in 19:92 with the explicit impossibility frame. Variant plural pressure, {{ar:وُلْدًا}} ({{tr:wuldan}}), is useful as scope evidence, but the canonical surface remains singular indefinite.

topics.headline: object and indefinite category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that {{ar:وَلَدًۭا}} ({{tr:waladan}}) is both the grammatical object and an open category: any attributed offspring would be the offense.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the word as an indefinite accusative direct object of the verb, supporting both object role and category-wide force.

topics.headline: concrete offspring field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word means offspring or child broadly, with birth and generatedness pressure, not just a male-son label.
topics.reason: V4 and contextual evidence support a concrete offspring field; the local noun should not be flattened into metaphorical favor or restricted to male sonship.

topics.headline: variant number scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that plural variant pressure tests the same target: the claim fails whether heard as one unspecified offspring or offspring as a plural category.
topics.reason: The variant reading is useful as scope apparatus, but the canonical local form remains singular indefinite {{ar:وَلَدًۭا}} ({{tr:waladan}}).

topics.headline: local and cross-surah echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word is a repeated test term: asserted at 19:88, causally exposed at 19:91, denied at 19:92, and echoed in wider denial formulas such as 17:111, 21:26, 43:81, and 112:3.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows provide concrete same-surah and cross-surah references, and the contextual profiles show frequent negation/scoping around this noun class.

topics.headline: closing and boundary pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word closes the cause-clause, answers the unresolved pressure from 19:90, and is immediately picked up by 19:92.
topics.reason: The word's final position, boundary rows, and immediate recurrence in 19:92 make the noun the closing acoustic and discourse pivot.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: دَعَوْا لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدًا joins an act of verbal claiming to an offspring object through the lām relation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The claim-and-lineage branch of د ع و makes the clause a speech-act that assigns filiation, while ر ح م supplies kinship and و ل د supplies the alleged offspring.

activation_trace.role: Claiming a right, affiliation, lineage, or child makes the verb the act that assigns filiation.
Near kinship and womb-relations supply the relational domain attached to al-Rahman.
An offspring descended by generation supplies the specific affiliation being claimed.

changed_reading.before: They called upon al-Rahman concerning a child.
changed_reading.after: They verbally claimed and assigned to al-Rahman an offspring affiliation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: الرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدًا places the womb field beside birth and generated-result fields.
baseline_models.mechanism: The womb as a child's container, parturition, and causal derivation together project an embodied or productive chain into the relation being asserted, not merely the label child.

activation_trace.role: The womb as the child's house and seedbed supplies a containing reproductive locus.
Birth and delivery supply the transition from contained gestation to offspring.
A thing produced or newly arising from another broadens offspring into causal derivation.

changed_reading.before: The clause merely assigns the noun child to al-Rahman.
changed_reading.after: The claim imports a whole womb-to-birth or source-to-derived-result mechanism into that relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence turns claimed filiation into an entitlement economy: child is anticipated beside wealth, backed by supposed access or covenant, fixed as an utterance, then stripped from a speaker who returns alone.

activation_trace.role: A claim of right and lineage anchors the focus clause as an asserted entitlement.
Saying or attributing what was not supplies the unsupported verbal projection.
Giving supplies the expected receipt under which wealth and offspring are paired.
Acquiring and multiplying property makes the adjacent offspring expectation read like an asset claim.
A preserved covenant supplies the tested warrant for the projected entitlement.
Transfer from a predecessor to an inheritor reverses the claimant's imagined acquisition.
The single person standing apart removes the wealth-and-offspring entourage projected by the claim.

structural_cues: 19:77 pairs wealth and offspring under promised receipt; 19:78 tests unseen access or covenant; 19:79 records the saying; 19:80 inherits it away and brings the speaker alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies receipt, property, covenant, recorded speech, inheritance, and solitude; I infer an entitlement-to-dispossession arrow. A live alternative is that these are consecutive accusations rather than one economic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus clause is an isolated genealogical assertion.
changed_reading.after: It is the culminating form of a projected entitlement in which offspring is treated like promised property, but the claimant's speech and holdings pass away while the claimant returns alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: Acquired divine allies are sought for strength but reverse into opponents, while intercession is governed by covenant; against that pattern, assigning a child becomes fabricated high kinship used to secure patronage and access.

activation_trace.role: Claimed affiliation and lineage anchor the focus as construction of privileged kinship.
Offspring supplies the highest claimed familial tie in the proposed patronage relation.
Acquisition and adoption supply the deliberate manufacture of protective allies.
Strengthening supplies the expected benefit of the manufactured affiliation.
Opposition that negates its counterpart supplies the reversal from ally to adversary.
An intercessor joining another supplies the sought proxy access.
A preserved covenant supplies the actual condition for access, displacing invented kinship.

structural_cues: 19:81 states the purpose of acquired gods as strength; 19:82 reverses them into opponents; 19:87 denies ownership of intercession except through covenant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquired allies, expected strengthening, reversal, intercessory joining, and covenant; I infer that sonship is another prestige-and-access strategy. Alternatively, the ally sequence and sonship claim may indict separate practices.

changed_reading.before: The alleged child is only a biological proposition.
changed_reading.after: The alleged child also functions as fabricated high kinship meant to guarantee strength, advocacy, and access, a guarantee the sequence relocates to covenant and can reverse into opposition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The claimed exceptional offspring relation is replaced by a universal relation of dependent service, exhaustive enumeration, and solitary arrival; no member escapes the total set as privileged kin.

activation_trace.role: Generated offspring supplies the exceptional family category that the later sequence dismantles.
Acquisition or adoption restates the proposed act as deliberate taking.
What yields, fits, or is appropriate supplies the explicit category-fit test and its failure.
Complete encompassing totality closes off an exceptional remainder.
Bonded or owned dependence supplies the universal relation opposed to privileged offspring status.
Exhaustive numerical reckoning makes every member individually accountable.
Counting the numbered supplies exact individuation within the totality.
Arrival as one standing apart removes inherited rank, entourage, and family exception.

structural_cues: 19:88 states the son claim; 19:92 rejects its fit; 19:93 uses an all-except construction; 19:94 doubles counting; 19:95 combines all of them with each arriving alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed suitability, all-encompassing service, exhaustive counting, and solitary arrival; I infer these as a relational replacement for claimed sonship. An alternative is that they only describe judgment logistics after a separate denial.

changed_reading.before: The clause grants one alleged being exceptional proximity by descent.
changed_reading.after: The clause attempts to carve out a genealogical exception where the sequence permits none: everyone is related as dependent servant, counted exhaustively, and brought singly.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same al-Rahman who is assigned an offspring in the focus instead makes affection for people characterized by trust and reparative action; relational nearness is enacted and bestowed rather than generated by blood.

activation_trace.role: Mercy, tenderness, and benefaction anchor al-Rahman as giver of relational good.
Near kinship supplies the bodily relation that the focus falsely assigns.
Offspring supplies inherited nearness against which bestowed affection is contrasted.
Heart-settling trust supplies one stated human condition of the new relation.
Purposive action supplies enacted rather than genealogical participation.
Repair opposed to corruption qualifies the actions associated with the relation.
Causing something to become a state supplies al-Rahman's active production of affection.
Love and affection supply the bestowed social bond that replaces imagined blood proximity.

structural_cues: 19:96 repeats al-Rahman as grammatical subject and gives trust, good action, and affection as a compact alternative relation-making sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated divine title, qualified people, causative making, and affection; I infer a contrast between generated kinship and bestowed relational nearness. Alternatively, 19:96 may begin a new consolatory movement without directly answering sonship.

changed_reading.before: Nearness to al-Rahman is imagined through offspring and blood.
changed_reading.after: The nearby alternative is nearness made as mercy and affection among trusting, repairing agents, not inherited through divine genealogy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is a verbal affiliation-claim; the close ends with language addressing hardened disputants and then asks whether vanished generations leave even a sensed presence or faint sound, reducing the grand claim to erasable acoustic residue.

activation_trace.role: Calling and inclining by speech anchor the focus claim as an audible linguistic act.
Claimed affiliation turns that speech into an attempted durable genealogy.
Tongue as language and speech supplies the medium in which claim and correction circulate.
Intense contentiousness supplies the social mode that keeps the claim in circulation.
Falling into destruction and extinction supplies the disappearance of prior claimants.
A barely perceptible movement or sound supplies the minimum residual trace being denied.
Auditory perception tests whether the uttering community leaves any acoustic presence.
A faint hidden sound supplies the final, vanishing scale of the once-grand claim.

structural_cues: 19:97 foregrounds tongue, announcement, warning, and dispute; 19:98 closes with paired questions about sensing anyone and hearing a faint sound.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a speech medium, contentious hearers, extinction, and denied acoustic residue; I infer that the focus claim's promised genealogy cannot secure the speaker's continuity. Alternatively, the final silence threatens communities generally rather than this utterance specifically.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports a proposition whose force lies only in its content.
changed_reading.after: It is also a contentious speech-act bidding for durable affiliation, yet the close miniaturizes such claims into a sound that can vanish with its speakers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the successive-fall branch is distant from the ordinary verbal form in 19:91 and must not replace its claim sense. It remains valid as a secondary echo because the branch belongs to the exact focus root and 19:90 supplies an ordered fracture-split-fall-demolition sequence; downstream prose should mark it as resonance, not translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root د ع و carries a branch of successive falling or demolition immediately after a staged cosmic collapse.

activation_trace.role: Successive falling and demolition supply an unexpected collapse echo inside the focus verb's root inventory.
Opening and splitting initiate the material cascade in the heavens.
Cleaving and opening continue the cascade through the earth.
Noisy, unstable falling carries the cascade into the mountains' motion.
Severe breaking and demolition complete the chain that the focus clause explains.

changed_reading.before: Cosmic collapse is merely an external reaction to the attribution.
changed_reading.after: As a contained root echo, the attribution and its consequence fold together: the act of claiming sonship faintly carries the image of one layer falling after another.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it personifies the cosmos and links remote branch images rather than giving the clause's lexical meaning. It remains anchored in the focus womb and birth branches and in 19:90's explicit bodily sequence of opening, splitting, falling, and breaking; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy of counterfeit labor, never as an asserted referent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الرَّحْمَٰنِ and وَلَدًا activate womb, post-birth pain, and parturition immediately after the cosmos strains and splits.

activation_trace.role: The womb as the child's container supplies the internal space presupposed by the false birth relation.
Womb pain associated with the aftermath of birth supplies the painful bodily register.
Parturition and delivery supply the birth event projected by the claim.
Opening and splitting supply the first contraction-like material rupture.
The earth's cleaving extends the rupture across a second containing layer.
The mountains' noisy fall supplies bodily collapse under the projected event.
Severe breaking supplies the catastrophic outcome of the counterfeit generative mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The cosmos is horrified by a proposition about a child.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory material analogy, the false birth claim makes the cosmos undergo a violent counterfeit labor across heavens, earth, and mountains.

strongest_changes: The exact claim-and-lineage branch of د ع و shifts the focus from generic calling to a verbal assignment of filiation.
19:77-80 recast that filiation as projected entitlement beside property, covenant, inheritance, and solitary return.
19:92-95 replace exceptional offspring status with universal service, exhaustive counting, and individual arrival.
19:96 offers bestowed affection through trust and reparative action as a non-genealogical relation to al-Rahman.
summary.what_was_special: The packet makes one short causal clause function simultaneously as a lineage claim, an entitlement and patronage device, a failed exception to universal individuation, and, in contained branch echoes, the mechanism of cosmic collapse or counterfeit labor.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the property-and-inheritance sequence directly models the sonship claim or only prepares its claimant type.
Whether the protective-alliance sequence and sonship are one patronage mechanism or parallel accusations.
Whether the 19:96 affection contrast is a direct relational answer or a new consolatory movement.
The collapse and labor outliers are branch-grounded resonances, not lexical replacements for دَعَوْا or a claim about the cosmos' literal body.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birinin belirli bir yöne veya yere şiddetle sevk edildiği yapılarda kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi, bir ölçek kabını veya başka bir taşıyıcıyı hareket ettirerek içindekini yerleştirme ve kabı dolu ya da sıkışık duruma getirme sürecini açıkça destekler. Sonuç bildiren doldurma kullanımları aynı işlemin doğal uzantısıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ayırıcı özellik yalnızca doluluk değil, kabı hareket ettirerek kapasitesini kullanma veya içeriği sıkıştırma sürecidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak doldurma sonucu ile kap, büyük çanak ve vadiye bağlı gerçekleşmeler ayrı tutulur; yapıya bağlı örnekler genel bir kök anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kabı hareket ettirerek içindekilerin yerleşmesini ve kabın dolmasını ya da sıkışık hale gelmesini sağlamak; uzantı olarak bir şeyi bütünüyle doldurmaktır.

facets.statement: Kabın hareket ettirilmesi, içeriğin yerleşmesini ve kullanılabilir hacmin dolmasını sağlar.
İşlemden doğan tam doluluk veya sıkışık doluluk sonucu ayrıca adlandırılır.
Büyük bir çanağın ya da bir vadinin tamamen dolması sonuç kullanımına örnektir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar kabı hareket ettirerek içeriği yerleştirme ile doluluk sonucu arasında birleşir; örnekler ölçek kabından çanak ve vadiye uzanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi sözcüğü kısa boylu adam için açıklar, fakat biçimin doğruluğunu koşullu verir ve başka bir biçimden ses değişimiyle gelmiş olabileceğini belirtir. Anlam korunabilir, ancak bağımsız ve üretken bir kök anlamı olduğu varsayılamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kısa boylu erkek kişiyi adlandırır; biçimin kökeni ve bağımsızlığı belirsiz olduğu için genel kısalık anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kabul edilmiş sözcük birimi bulunmadığından dalın çıplak veya yapıya bağlı olduğu varsayılmaz; tanım yalnızca aktarılan kişi niteliğini kaydeder.

concept_map.definition: Kısa boylu bir erkeği niteleyen, biçimsel doğruluğu ve başka bir sözcükten ses değişimiyle gelip gelmediği belirsiz bir adlandırmadır.

facets.statement: Adlandırmanın gönderimi kısa boylu erkek kişidir.
Biçimin başka bir kısa-boy adlandırmasından ses değişimiyle gelmiş olması mümkündür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar kısa boylu erkek anlamını desteklerken biçimin bağımsızlığı konusunda ihtiyat kaydı taşır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Belirsiz köken kaydını anlamın içine katmadan aktarılan kişi niteliğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Erkek kişi gönderimini ve kısa boy niteliğini tam olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nadir adlandırmanın açıklayıcı ve doğal Türkçe karşılığı gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin cinsiyetini ve boyca kısa oluşunu doğrudan korur.
Boyca kısa olma niteliğini korur.
error_profile.adds: İnsan dışındaki bitki ve nesnelere, ayrıca tıknazlığa uzanan kapsam ekler.
error_profile.collision: Türkçede kısa boy yanında gövdece sıkı veya gelişmemiş olma çağrışımı taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kısa boylu erkek için özel ve kökeni belirsiz bir adlandırmadır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kişi ve cisimlerde kısalığı genel bir nitelik olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: özel kısa-adam adı ile genel kısalık
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir insanın boyca kısa oluşunu ifade edebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın gönderimi erkek kişiyle ve belirli bir adlandırmayla sınırlıdır; komşu dal ise kısalık niteliğini daha geniş varlık sınıflarında anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yalnızca kısa boylu erkek gönderimini verir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kısa olmanın yanında bedenin toplu ve yaratılışça kısalmış görünmesini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kısa adam ile kısa ve toplu yapı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki adlandırma kısa boylu bir erkeğe uygulanabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal için kısa boy yeterlidir; komşu dalın sınırında toplu beden yapısı ve boyun kesilmiş gibi oluşuna ilişkin ek bir tasarım vardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi iki yakın görünümü birlikte aktarır: iki hurma ağacı arasındaki açıklık ve seyrek duran hurma ağaçları. Ayrıca sözcüğün ilk ünsüzünün başka bir biçimde aktarılmış olabileceği belirtilir; bu nedenle dal hem yerleşim anlamını hem yazım belirsizliğini korumalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hurmaların seyrekliği veya iki hurma arasındaki açıklıkla sınırlıdır; küçük hurma, toplu hurmalık ya da genel ağaçlık anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kabul edilmiş sözcük birimi bulunmadığından çıplaklık varsayılmaz; yalnızca seyrek hurmalar ve aralarındaki açıklık aktarılır.

concept_map.definition: Seyrek duran hurma ağaçlarını veya iki hurma ağacı arasında kalan açıklığı anlatan, ilk ünsüzü konusunda aktarım ayrılığı bulunan bir adlandırmadır.

facets.statement: Hurma ağaçları bitişik bir topluluk değil, aralıklı ve seyrek durumdadır.
Adlandırma iki hurma ağacı arasında kalan boşluğa da uygulanır.
Sözcüğün ilk ünsüzü başka bir sesle aktarılmış bir biçime ait olabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek aktarım seyrek hurmalar ile iki hurma arasındaki açıklığı aynı adlandırmada birleştirir ve biçim için bir ses varyantı kaydeder.

source_details.summary: Seyrek hurmalar, aralarındaki açıklık ve olası ses varyantı bu tek tanıklıkta birlikte korunur.

concept_gloss.text: iki hurma arasındaki açıklık veya seyrek hurmalar

error_profile.preserves: Hurma türünü, seyrek yerleşimi ve iki ağaç arasındaki açıklığı korur.

error_profile.preserves: Hurma ağaçlarının aralıklı ve dağınık oluşunu korur.
error_profile.loses: İki belirli hurma arasındaki açıklık kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

error_profile.preserves: Birden çok hurma ağacının bulunduğu alanı ifade eder.
error_profile.loses: Ağaçların seyrekliği ve iki ağaç arasındaki açıklık özelliklerini belirtmez.
error_profile.adds: Sık veya düzenli dikilmiş her türlü hurma bahçesini kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Toplu ve düzenli hurma bahçesi anlamıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal hurmaların bir topluluk veya küme halinde bulunmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da birden çok hurma ağacının mekansal düzenini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortak düzen ekseninde odak dal aralık ve dağınıklığı, komşu dal ise ağaçların bir araya gelerek topluluk oluşturmasını öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal ağaçların birbirine göre seyrek yerleşimini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal hurmaların yaşça veya gelişimce küçük oluşunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir hurma ağacı topluluğunu betimleyebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ölçütü ağaçlar arasındaki mesafedir; komşu dalın ölçütü ise ağaçların büyüklüğü veya gelişim evresidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın tohum anlamı, benzerlikle adlandırılan karınca ve tohum toplayan adamı bildiren özel yapıdan ayrılır; yapıdaki kişi anlamı çıplak dala taşınmaz.

facets.statement: Temel gönderim yabani bir bitkinin tohumudur.

facets.statement: Bir başkasının durumu karşısında yüreğin yumuşaması, ona acıma ve içten yakınlık duyma çekirdeği oluşturur.
Bu iç yöneliş, acınan kişiyi esirgemeyi ve ona iyilikte bulunmayı gerektiren etkin bir sonuç taşır.
Topluluğun bireylerinin birbirine acıyıp birbirini esirgemesi, çekirdeğin karşılıklı bir kuruluşta gerçekleşmesidir.
Bir kimsenin Tanrı'nın esirgemesine erişmesini dilemek, çekirdek anlamdan doğan kalıplaşmış bir söz eylemidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Hazırlanan başlık doğumdan sonraki ağrıyı doğru bir merkez olarak gösterse de yetkili kaynak anlatımı bundan daha geniştir: dişi deve, koyun veya kadında döl yatağının ağrıması ya da hastalanması yanında şişme ve koyunun doğumdan sonra yavru zarını atamaması da aynı dalda yer alır. Dal bölünmeden korunabilir, fakat tanım yalnızca doğum sonrası ağrıyla sınırlandırılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sağlıklı organı veya genel beden ağrısını değil, döl yatağına özgü ağrı, hastalık, şişme ve doğum sonrası yavru zarını atamama durumlarını kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Verilen biçimler döl yatağına özgü hastalık ve doğum sonrası bozuklukları bağımsız olarak adlandırır; tanım başka bir kalıptan yalın anlama aktarım yapmaz.

concept_map.definition: Dişi deve, koyun veya kadında döl yatağının ağrıması ya da hastalanmasıyla; koyunda ise ayrıca şişmesiyle belirlenen durumdur. Bazı kullanımlar bunu doğum sonrasına bağlar. Koyunun doğumdan sonra yavru zarını atamaması da bu organ çevresindeki özel bir bozukluk olarak dala dahildir.

facets.statement: Dişi hayvan veya kadında döl yatağının ağrıması ya da hastalanması temel durumdur; özellikle bazı kullanımlarda bu durum doğum sonrasında görülür.
Koyunun doğum yaptıktan sonra yavru zarını dışarı atamaması, dala bağlı özel bir doğum sonrası bozukluktur.
Koyun veya koyun sürüsünde döl yatağının şişmesi, hastalık durumunun özel bir gerçekleşmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, dişi deve, koyun veya kadının döl yatağında ağrı ya da hastalık bulunmasını temel alır. Kaynakların bir bölümü bunu özellikle doğum sonrasına bağlar. Toplu anlatım ayrıca koyunda organın şişmesini ve doğumdan sonra yavru zarının atılamamasını aynı organ çevresindeki özel durumlar olarak kaydeder.
